summary: MaintSite is the administrative interface for maintaining and managing Site records in HSPnet. It allows authorized users to view, add, edit, reactivate, and inactivate Site entries, including address, contact, governing organization, portfolio, and student number request settings. System and business rules ensure proper validation, role-based access, and detailed workflow for Site management.
purpose: To provide a central, structured interface for authorized users to manage Site information, including core fields, address, contact details, portfolio assignments, and governing organization linkage, enforcing strict validations and configurable behaviors based on business and user role requirements.

workflows.name: Site Management
steps: Dropdowns for Agency and GoverningOrg are dynamically populated.
User selects/adds/edits a Site record from the grid.
Fields are presented for editing/addition based on configured business rules.
Validation applied on save: required fields, phone/fax format, Portfolio required if UseCostCentres enabled, GoverningOrg required.
Save, cancel, reactivate, delete and other commands processed through the UI.
Role restrictions enforced: only sysadmins may add sites, edit name/short name; address-only edits for non-sysadmins.

business_rules: Only System Administrators can add new Sites.
Editing Site name and short name is restricted to System Administrators.
Address edits may be permitted for Placement Coordinators if ServiceUser does not exist.
Portfolio dropdown required if UseCostCentres is checked.
GoverningOrg dropdown is mandatory unless configuration disables.
Position number fields hidden if Use Student HR Information config is not set.
Deletion of Sites disallowed if service or destination codes exist or site is inactive.
Reactivate only allowed if user has edit permissions.
Validation required for phone/fax formats if UsePhoneMask config is enabled.
StudentNumber checkbox may be hidden based on configuration.
validations: Name and ShortName are required fields.
Phone and Fax fields must match mask/format if enabled.
GoverningOrg must be specified unless default blank option is configured.
Portfolio required if UseCostCentres is enabled and portfolios exist.
Custom validators for phone, fax, governing org, and portfolio fields.
Control visibility and enablement based on user role, screen editability, and configuration.
conditions: PortfolioCodeID set to 0 if UseCostCentres is false.
GoverningOrg dropdown may include blank or parent agency option depending on configuration code.
Position numbers and PAAllocatePositionNumbers enabled only if UseStudentHRInformation config is '1' and user is sysadmin.
system_behavior: Dynamic UI element visibility and enablement based on user role, agency, and configuration.
Dropdowns populated from search APIs or configuration at page load.
UI refreshes and updates using AJAX UpdatePanel triggers.
Help panels, glossary links, and portfolio help dynamically linked.
Error and warning panels, feedback messages processed and displayed.
Add/Edit forms surfaced as modal pop-ups.
dependencies: Agency selection controls UI state and editable fields.
Dropdown values depend on configuration codes and search APIs.
Portfolio and GoverningOrg controls depend on site and agency data.
UserSession impacts visibility, enablement, and filter controls.
exceptions: If user is not authorized, add/edit/reactivate commands not available.
Delete operation fails if dependent services or destination codes exist.
Validators prevent save if required fields or formats are missing/invalid.
StudentNumber checkbox hidden for certain configurations.
content_gaps: No explicit user stories or sample data provided.
Behavior for unexpected errors and failed saves is only implied.
Exact configuration values for portfolio and governing org dropdown behaviors are referenced but not enumerated.
